name: Oomori Tasuku
source:
A suspicious man who turns up as a trespasser on Kirishima land.
He has a strange tribalistic tattoo on his arm, but he doesn't seem to be a yakuza, and his true identity is unknown.
He's extremely shady. He's friendly and talkative, but everything he says sounds like nonsense. However, it seems that it is not in his nature to get discouraged even when he is beaten, and he could even be called a "lovable jester"...
He acts as if he knows something about the Kirishima family and brings up some dubious stories.

[Translated from [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/pigeon/]Official site[/url]]
